p: 183 Jiading South St (嘉定区嘉定南大街183号; Jiādìngqū Jiādìngnándàjiē​)
Large and well preserved temple built in 1219. Nowadays it is mostly a museum of Chinese imperial examination. On Apple Map you can search for Jiading Confucius Temple or Shanghai China Keju Museum.

History museum with a modern design, having exhibits in real size: Chinese pavilions, people (craftsmen), large animals. Ceramic exhibition in the basement (as of 2018). The backyard has an elegant pond with water lilies, and the other…
Built in 1502, this is one of Shanghai's famous old gardens. Former private garden of Gon Hong, a head of the Ministry of Works in the Ming Dynasty. A pleasant, compact, classical garden.

This 40.85 meters tall tetragonal brick-wood tower with seven floors is the symbol of Jiading. It was first constructed during Emperor Kaixi's reign (1205-1207). As of 2018 it's not possible to climb the pagoda, but it is free to walk…
